column3: “Eye looked with compassion” is rendered “My eye spared.”
“Turned back my hand” is rendered “withdrew My hand.”
“Made unclean” is rendered “pronounced them unclean,” and NASB supplies “the fire.”
“Lifted up my hand” is rendered “swore,” and “leafy tree” for “thick tree.”
“Bamah” (high place) is kept as a name.
